description: This Java source file defines the 'HiveMqtt3ClientActor' class, which is an Akka actor responsible for managing MQTT 3.1.1 protocol connections within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes factory methods for actor creation, overrides key connection management methods, and coordinates child actors for publishing and consuming MQTT messages.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ClientActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages MQTT 3.1.1 connection lifecycle, including creating subscription handlers, initiating connect/disconnect, and starting publisher and consumer child actors within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
